data.rationale: The proposal follows the true flow (city, browse/search to the event, ticket count, Book Now tier, Reserve Now) but is generalized to restaurants and party sizes. It leaves out the Special Events & Experiences section and the date, and it treats the search and browse routes as alternatives, so an automation would need guesswork to reach the event.
